subject: reasoning
question: Harshit starts from Point A and drives 6 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 6 km, turns right and drives 12 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a39dab0f2ef582a60ded8f91dc5018fc9e710af527142d574a7df3a0c810c3.png] 

Distance = 5 km

Direction from P to A = South

**∴ Required shortest distance = 5 km towards South.**

Hence the correct answer is** Option 1.**
